# Test fixtures

Real files from other programs. They are used only for interoperability tests and keep their original licences. Each file has a `*.source.txt` with the exact URL and commit.

| File | Origin | Licence |
|---|---|---|
| `ekos/start_at_finish_at_test.esl`, `ekos/3x30s_Red.esq` | KStars test fixtures, `Tests/ekos/scheduler/`, branch stable-3.8.5 (commit 65977fded4aed4e8d878cebb7df0a6f140782959) | GPL-2.0-or-later (KStars) |
| `nina/nina-official_v3.2_all-sequence-entities.sequence.json` | NINA test corpus generated by NINA's serializer from tag Version-3.2 (`NINA.Test/Sequencer/Serialization/LegacySequences/v3.2/`) | MPL-2.0 (N.I.N.A.) |
| `nina/nina-official_example_Basic-Sequence-Target.template.json` | NINA built-in example template | MPL-2.0 (N.I.N.A.) |
| `nina/plugin-exoplanets_TransitPlanetImagingSequence.json` | ExoPlanets plugin example sequence, NINA 2.x format (github.com/NickHardy/ExoPlanets) | MPL-2.0 (ExoPlanets plugin) |
| `astropy-reference.json` | Generated by `tools/reference/make_fixtures.py` with astropy 8.0.3 | MIT (this project) |
